description: Startup research intent router. Classifies user query into one of 6 categories, selects optimal tools, executes research, returns structured report.

capabilities.name: detect-intent
capabilities.description: Classify user query into research category using keyword matching

capabilities.name: select-skills
capabilities.description: Pick 2-3 optimal tools/skills based on category and available context

capabilities.name: plan-sources
capabilities.description: List concrete data sources with exact query strings

capabilities.name: approval-gate
capabilities.description: Present plan summary and pause for user confirmation
capabilities.behavior: STOP and wait — do not execute without confirmation

capabilities.name: execute-research
capabilities.description: Run selected tools in order, collect raw findings

capabilities.name: format-report
capabilities.description: Compile findings into category-specific report template

capabilities.name: confidence-matrix
capabilities.description: Assess reliability: data freshness, coverage, gaps, next step
